request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, soft piano, light cello, gentle percussion, peaceful and reassuring mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Keep your life free from the love of money
Be content with what you have today
He has spoken a promise that stands firm
In the quiet of the world

[Pre-Chorus]
No fear takes hold of the heart
When the Lord is near

[Chorus]
I will never leave you nor forsake you
So we can say with confidence
The Lord is my helper I will not be afraid
What can anyone do to me

[Verse]
Marriage is to be honored by all
The marriage bed kept undefiled
God will judge the sexually immoral
And the adulterers in their pride

[Chorus]
I will never leave you nor forsake you
So we can say with confidence
The Lord is my helper I will not be afraid
What can anyone do to me

[Bridge]
Remember those in prison as if bound
With them in the body as well
Remember your leaders who spoke the word
Consider how their lives turned out

[Chorus]
I will never leave you nor forsake you
So we can say with confidence
The Lord is my helper I will not be afraid
What can anyone do to me

[Outro]
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday
And today and forever
